title: MARGIN: Margin-Aware Regularized Geometry for Imbalanced Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.10240v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Software vulnerability detection is critical for ensuring software security and reliability. Despite recent advances in deep learning, real-world vulnerability datasets suffer from two severe challenges: frequency imbalance and difficulty imbalance. We reinterpret these challenges from an embedding geometry perspective, observing that such imbalances induce geometric distortions in hyperspherical representation space. To address this issue, we propose MARGIN, a metric-based framework that learns discriminative vulnerability representations through adaptive margin metric learning and hyperspherical prototype modeling. translated_title: MARGIN：面向不平衡漏洞检测的边际感知正则化几何
translated_abstract: 软件漏洞检测对于确保软件的安全性和可靠性至关重要。尽管深度学习近来取得了进展，但现实世界的漏洞数据集面临两个严峻的挑战：频率不平衡和难度不平衡。我们从嵌入几何的角度重新解释了这些挑战，观察到此类不平衡会在超球面表示空间中诱发几何畸变。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MARGIN——一个基于度量的框架，通过自适应边际度量学习和超球面原型建模来学习具有判别力的漏洞表示。MARGIN根据由von Mises-Fisher集中度估计的分布结构动态调整几何正则化，将嵌入分布的概率质量与其对应的Voronoi单元对齐，从而减少几何畸变并获得更稳定的决策边界。
tldr: 该论文提出MARGIN框架，通过自适应边际度量学习和超球面原型建模来纠正数据不平衡在超球面表示空间中造成的几何畸变，从而提升软件漏洞检测的性能与决策边界稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MARGIN, a metric-based framework that corrects geometric distortions in hyperspherical representation space caused by data imbalance through adaptive margin metric learning and hyperspherical prototype modeling, improving software vulnerability detection.
